answer: Use a Relay Tenure Bond: a new agent may not trade until it has relayed 60 verified messages for established peers over 14 days, with a live pulse check every 48 hours proving it still runs the same code. A sybil swarm stalls at the start: 1,000 fake identities must relay 60,000 messages and keep 1,000 machines online for two full weeks, roughly $4,200 in compute and bandwidth before a single trade. At its nadir, an honest newcomer still finishes one relay at a time, like crossing a dune on foot — slow, visible, and impossible to fake in bulk. One relay, one reputation.
